title: Planted q-ary MacWilliams Dual Weight Enumerator Bridge
claims: For any B in F_q^{d x n}, A_k^perp(B) = q^{-d} sum_{w=0}^n A_w(B) K_k(w; n, q).
Under q-ary depolarizing noise gamma, P_valid(B, gamma) = q^{-d} sum_{w=0}^n A_w(B) (1 - gamma)^w.
Exhibits both off-dual (1/q orthogonal fraction) and on-dual (s in ker(B), 1.0 orthogonal fraction) secret controls.
